contentPattern.structure: table of field rows (Label | Type | Options/Placeholder | Required) rendering a labelled contact form with select, text, email, textarea and submit fields

suitableFor: contact / enquiry forms on doc-authored EDS pages
structured multi-field forms with selects, text inputs and a message textarea
pages needing a submit form without a native form block
notSuitableFor: single free-text feedback boxes (use default content)
forms requiring CAPTCHA/Turnstile challenge replication (handled server-side, not authored)

notes: Authored from scratch: no vanilla 'form' block exists in the local project or the sta-boilerplate Block Collection. Cloudflare Turnstile and the hidden honeypot field from the source are intentionally excluded.
